crossRefs.note: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of…
and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

translations.web: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
translations.bsb: Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
translations.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
translations.asv: And they indeed have been made priests many in number, because that by death they are hindered from continuing:
